svg.text: Arm 1 picks a PCB holder with its vacuum pump
Prox 1 detects the holder → conveyor 1 runs
Prox 2 at point B → Arm 2 grips the holder
Arm 2 reaches its trigger position → Arm 3 brings the PCB
Arms 2 + 3 mount the PCB on the holder
Arm 2 places the assembly on conveyor 2 (Prox 3)
Conveyor 2 carries the board to the exit
